title: 6 November
subtitle: in Bapa’s Diary

story.line: Pramukh Swami Maharaj dedicates Akshardham in Delhi with President Kalam

whatsapp:
🪔 Tomorrow, Saturday 7 November, is Kali Chaudas and Bhagatji Maharaj Smrutiparva

On this day in 2005, Pramukh Swami Maharaj performed the pratishtha of the murtis in Swaminarayan Akshardham, New Delhi, completed in just five years.
